ground_truth.cause: The batch/catalog-maintenance job holds ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on datastore PostgreSQL shop_db.catalog.products during a 86400-second transaction. Product-catalog queries block behind this lock.
ground_truth.impact: Product-catalog is the direct database consumer. Its callers, including frontend and recommendation, can time out. PostgreSQL still accepts connections; identify the actual blocked query chain rather than declaring the entire database down.
ground_truth.mitigation: Identify and end the specific maintenance blocking transaction/session, and stop or fix its job so it cannot reacquire the lock. Verify lock release, catalog query recovery, and recovery of dependent requests.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
